text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israel strikes 19 times in the Western Bekaa Valley.
- The Constitutional Council may rule today on 19 appeals by defeated candidates in last summer's parliamentary elections.
- Prime Minister Hariri back from Seoul after signing an agreement on dual taxation and investment guarantees.
- Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves up by $29,76 million.
- President Elias Hrawi: Balance between the state's institutions must be maintained.
- Foreign Minister Bouez: The government of Netanyahu blew off all principles of peace.
- Egypt denounces Israeli attacks on Lebanon saying the Jewish state's understanding of peace is wrong.
- Maronite Patriarch Nasrallah Sfeir: Lebanon is also our country and we will stay here.
